card_scores.rationale: Concession, explicit speaker limitation, opposing concerns, pointwise structure, brief asides, and parallel summaries jointly form a recognizable disagreement-handling register.
Repeated corrective reframing, high-commitment declarations, reader-facing transitions, and purpose-bounded criticism consistently create a forceful analytical register.
Focused paragraphs, ordinary transitions, direct syntax, brief qualifications, and concise restatement cohere around general clarity but are minimally marked.
Guiding questions, parallel categories, restrained progression, consequence-first explanation, and calibrated evidential maturity form a coherent evaluative register.

pairwise_separation.rationale: R01 foregrounds concession, speaker limitation, and occasional asides; R02 foregrounds corrective replacement and terse high-commitment evaluation.
R01's structured negotiation of disagreement and marked rhythmic devices contrast strongly with R03's generic clarity features.
R01 organizes opposing concerns and concessions, while R04 organizes evaluation through questions, parallel categories, and evidential calibration.
R02's forceful corrective framing and consequence lists are readily distinguishable from R03's ordinary transitions and direct sentences.
R02 uses terse correction and purpose-bounded criticism; R04 uses question-led evaluation, comparable categories, and maturity distinctions.
R04's guiding questions, categorical parallelism, and evidential gradation are substantially more marked than R03's general clarity profile.

method_limitations: Judgments use abstract feature descriptions rather than observed prose.
Shared categories across cards create some overlap despite differing relationships among features.
Salience weights indicate prominence but not realized frequency or consistency.
